instructions: See .kit-shell/prompts/NEW-PROJECT.md for the workflow. When done, run `node .kit-shell/scripts/kit-staging-export.mjs` to produce a tarball for transport to the kit machine.
note: This .kit-shell/ was hand-assembled, not produced by kit-new-project-shell.mjs, because that scaffolder only creates NEW project directories (errors if target exists) and this project already existed. kit-staging-export.mjs was added manually because kit-new-project-shell.mjs's shellFiles list omits it (a real bug, reported separately).
